english.note: Use this when the money specifically means coins or small change carried for minor purchases.

examples.english: I still have some pocket money in loose change in my wallet, just enough to buy a bottle of water.
examples.traditional: 我個銀包入面仲有啲零錢，買支水啱啱好。
